```{r setup}
library(jsonlite)
library(corrplot)
data_dir    <- "RawData"
summary_dir <- "SummaryData"
dir.create(summary_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# T* = temporal masking, S* = spatial masking
temporal_tasks   <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi")
spatial_tasks    <- c("SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
perceptual_tasks <- c(temporal_tasks, spatial_tasks)
cognitive_tasks  <- c("OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
all_tasks        <- c(perceptual_tasks, cognitive_tasks)

# scores beyond this many SDs from the task mean are removed
sd_cutoff <- 4
```

```{r read-perceptual}
# raw columns holding the stimulus and the two staircases' stimulus levels
perceptual_column_map <- list(
  TLetter = list(stimulus_col = "letter",      level1_col = "soa1",      level2_col = "soa2"),
  TGabor  = list(stimulus_col = "orientation", level1_col = "soa1",      level2_col = "soa2"),
  TPi     = list(stimulus_col = "orientation", level1_col = "soa1",      level2_col = "soa2"),
  SLetter = list(stimulus_col = "letter",      level1_col = "alpha1",    level2_col = "alpha2"),
  SGabor  = list(stimulus_col = "orientation", level1_col = "contrast1", level2_col = "contrast2"),
  SPi     = list(stimulus_col = "orientation", level1_col = "diff1",     level2_col = "diff2")
)

# read all individuals' trial files of one perceptual task
read_perceptual_task <- function(task) {
  columns      <- perceptual_column_map[[task]]
  task_folder  <- file.path(data_dir, task, "Data")
  file_pattern <- paste0("_", task, "\\.csv$")
  files        <- list.files(task_folder, pattern = file_pattern, full.names = TRUE)

  per_individual <- lapply(files, function(file) {
    trials <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    data.frame(
      id        = sub(file_pattern, "", basename(file)),
      task_name = task,
      session   = trials$session,
      trial     = trials$trial,
      staircase = trials$staircase,
      stimulus  = trials[[columns$stimulus_col]],
      response  = trials$response,
      correct   = trials$correct,
      param1    = trials[[columns$level1_col]],
      param2    = trials[[columns$level2_col]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, per_individual)
}

perceptual_trials <- do.call(rbind, lapply(perceptual_tasks, read_perceptual_task))
write.csv(perceptual_trials, file.path(summary_dir, "all_perceptual_scores.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r read-span}
# read the summary scores of one span task ("OSpan" or "CSpan")
read_span_task <- function(task) {
  task_folder  <- file.path(data_dir, task, "Data_summary")
  file_pattern <- paste0("_", task, "_summary\\.csv$")
  files        <- list.files(task_folder, pattern = file_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  score_column <- if (task == "OSpan") "ospan_absolute" else "abs_perfect_sum"

  per_individual <- lapply(files, function(file) {
    summary_row <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    data.frame(id        = sub(file_pattern, "", basename(file)),
               task_name = task,
               score     = summary_row[[score_column]],
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  do.call(rbind, per_individual)
}

span_scores <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("OSpan", "CSpan"), read_span_task))
```

```{r read-corsi-matrix}
# lookup tables: individual id -> server code -> logging name (JSON file prefix)
pid_map  <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "Matrix", "pid.csv"),
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
code_map <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "Matrix", "code.csv"),
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# a task may have been started several times: keep the last non-empty battery
pick_last_valid_battery <- function(batteries) {
  summary_lengths <- sapply(batteries, function(battery) length(battery$Summary))
  valid_positions <- which(summary_lengths > 0)
  if (length(valid_positions) == 0) return(NULL)
  batteries[[valid_positions[length(valid_positions)]]]
}

corsi_scores_list  <- vector("list", nrow(pid_map))
matrix_scores_list <- vector("list", nrow(pid_map))

for (row in seq_len(nrow(pid_map))) {
  id           <- pid_map$Pid[row]
  server_code  <- pid_map$`Server code`[row]
  subject_id   <- paste0("sycm", server_code)
  code_row     <- match(subject_id, code_map$`Subject ID`)
  logging_name <- code_map$`Logging Name`[code_row]

  json_path <- list.files(file.path(data_dir, "Matrix"),
                          pattern = paste0("^", logging_name, ".*\\.json$"),
                          full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  raw_json  <- fromJSON(json_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)

  battery_names    <- sapply(raw_json$data, function(battery) battery$Battery)
  corsi_positions  <- grep("corsi",       battery_names, ignore.case = TRUE)
  matrix_positions <- grep("wircs|ucmrt", battery_names, ignore.case = TRUE)

  # Corsi: number of correct responses in the correct spot
  corsi_battery <- pick_last_valid_battery(raw_json$data[corsi_positions])
  corsi_score   <- NA
  if (!is.null(corsi_battery)) {
    corsi_summary <- corsi_battery$Summary
    last_summary  <- corsi_summary[[length(corsi_summary)]]
    corsi_score <- ifelse(
      !is.null(last_summary$TotalCorrectResponsesCorrectSpot),
      last_summary$TotalCorrectResponsesCorrectSpot,
      last_summary$CorrectResponsesCorrectSpot
    )
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("id %s: no matched corsi battery, skipped", id))
  }
  corsi_scores_list[[row]] <- data.frame(id = as.character(id),
                                         task_name = "Corsi", score = corsi_score)

  # matrix reasoning: number of correctly solved matrices
  matrix_battery <- pick_last_valid_battery(raw_json$data[matrix_positions])
  matrix_score   <- NA
  if (!is.null(matrix_battery)) {
    matrix_score <- matrix_battery$Summary[[1]]$Hits
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("id %s (logging name = %s): no matched matrix battery, skipped",
                    id, logging_name))
  }
  matrix_scores_list[[row]] <- data.frame(id = as.character(id),
                                          task_name = "Matrix", score = matrix_score)
}

corsi_matrix_scores <- rbind(do.call(rbind, corsi_scores_list),
                             do.call(rbind, matrix_scores_list))

cognitive_scores    <- rbind(span_scores, corsi_matrix_scores)
cognitive_scores$id <- as.character(cognitive_scores$id)
write.csv(cognitive_scores, file.path(summary_dir, "all_cognitive_scores.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r summary-scores}
perceptual_trials <- read.csv(file.path(summary_dir, "all_perceptual_scores.csv"))
cognitive_scores  <- read.csv(file.path(summary_dir, "all_cognitive_scores.csv"))

# stimulus level of a trial: param1 on staircase 2, param2 otherwise
perceptual_trials$level <- ifelse(perceptual_trials$staircase == 2,
                                  perceptual_trials$param1,
                                  perceptual_trials$param2)

# perceptual score = mean stimulus level over the last 150 trials
perceptual_trials <- perceptual_trials[order(perceptual_trials$id,
                                             perceptual_trials$task_name,
                                             perceptual_trials$session,
                                             perceptual_trials$trial,
                                             perceptual_trials$staircase), ]
perceptual_scores <- aggregate(
  level ~ id + task_name, data = perceptual_trials,
  FUN       = function(x) round(mean(tail(x, 150), na.rm = TRUE), 4),
  na.action = na.pass
)
names(perceptual_scores)[3] <- "score"

# long -> wide: one row per individual, one column per task
all_scores <- reshape(rbind(perceptual_scores, cognitive_scores),
                      idvar = "id", timevar = "task_name", direction = "wide")
names(all_scores) <- sub("^score\\.", "", names(all_scores))

# flip cognitive scores so that higher = poorer, as for perceptual thresholds
all_scores[cognitive_tasks] <- -all_scores[cognitive_tasks]
all_scores <- all_scores[c("id", perceptual_tasks, cognitive_tasks)]
```

```{r clean-scores}
zscore <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

# log-transform thresholds, drop scores beyond sd_cutoff SDs, then z-score
all_scores_clean <- all_scores
all_scores_clean[perceptual_tasks] <- log(all_scores_clean[perceptual_tasks])
all_scores_clean[all_tasks] <- lapply(all_scores_clean[all_tasks], function(x)
  zscore(replace(x, abs(zscore(x)) > sd_cutoff, NA)))

# number of scores removed per task
cat("Excluded per task:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(all_scores_clean[all_tasks])) - colSums(is.na(all_scores[all_tasks])))

write.csv(all_scores,       file.path(summary_dir, "all_scores.csv"),       row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_scores_clean, file.path(summary_dir, "all_scores_clean.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r correlations}
cor_matrix <- cor(all_scores_clean[all_tasks], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", addCoef.col = "black",
         number.cex = 0.6, tl.col = "black")

# mean correlations
lower_triangle <- function(m) m[lower.tri(m)]
cat(sprintf("Same-stimulus pairs (temporal vs. spatial): %.3f\n",
            mean(diag(cor_matrix[temporal_tasks, spatial_tasks]))))
cat(sprintf("Within temporal masking:                    %.3f\n",
            mean(lower_triangle(cor_matrix[temporal_tasks, temporal_tasks]))))
cat(sprintf("Within spatial masking:                     %.3f\n",
            mean(lower_triangle(cor_matrix[spatial_tasks, spatial_tasks]))))
cat(sprintf("Perceptual to cognitive:                    %.3f\n",
            mean(cor_matrix[perceptual_tasks, cognitive_tasks])))
```

```{r clustering}
# plot labels, group membership, and group symbols
task_label <- c(TLetter = "Letter", TGabor = "Gabor", TPi = "Pi",
                SLetter = "Letter", SGabor = "Gabor", SPi = "Pi",
                OSpan = "OSPAN", CSpan = "CSPAN", Corsi = "SSPAN", Matrix = "UCMRT")
task_group <- c(TLetter = "T", TGabor = "T", TPi = "T",
                SLetter = "S", SGabor = "S", SPi = "S",
                OSpan = "C", CSpan = "C", Corsi = "C", Matrix = "C")
group_symbol <- c(T = 15, S = 17, C = 16)
group_legend <- c(T = "Temporal masking", S = "Spatial masking", C = "Cognitive task")
n_tasks <- length(all_tasks)

# average-linkage clustering, distance = 1 - r; masking tasks on the left
cluster_tree <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_matrix), method = "average")
dendrogram   <- reorder(as.dendrogram(cluster_tree), wts = seq_len(n_tasks),
                        agglo.FUN = mean)
leaf_order   <- all_tasks[order.dendrogram(dendrogram)]

# y range: room below for labels, above for the legend
y_min <- floor((min(cluster_tree$height) - 0.05) * 10) / 10
y_max <- max(cluster_tree$height) + 0.20

par(mar = c(3.2, 4.5, 1, 1), xpd = FALSE, yaxs = "i")
plot(dendrogram, leaflab = "none", ylim = c(y_min, y_max), yaxt = "n",
     edgePar = list(lwd = 1.4))
axis(2, at = seq(y_min, max(cluster_tree$height) + 0.06, by = 0.10),
     las = 1, cex.axis = 0.75, tcl = -0.3)
mtext("Distance", side = 2, line = 3, cex = 0.85)

# symbols and labels below the leaves, legend above the tree
par(xpd = NA)
points(seq_len(n_tasks), rep(y_min, n_tasks),
       pch = group_symbol[task_group[leaf_order]], cex = 1.3)
text(seq_len(n_tasks), y_min - 0.045, task_label[leaf_order], cex = 0.8)
legend(x = 0.5, y = y_max, xjust = 0, yjust = 1,
       legend = group_legend, pch = group_symbol,
       bty = "n", cex = 0.8, pt.cex = 1.1)
par(xpd = FALSE)
```
